declarations.name: Theorem Y1. General four-core description
declarations.scope: For all four lengths>=2, N=a1+a2+b1+b2-2, deleting T leaves two AB components. The core is a matching, either colored two-edge star plus an isolated heavy-cycle vertex, or an alternating four-cycle-vertex path plus one isolated sheet. AB is full on each component. Paths are determined by the internal/leaf role choices and two oriented distances in1..|Ai|-1 and1..|Bi|-1, with one T anchor, and every choice occurs.

declarations.name: Lemma Y2. Every nonaligned matching escapes
declarations.scope: Under pure braids and absolute relabeling, every star reaches a path. A matching has periodic support words O B^(b-1) A^(a-1) on its components. Any differing endpoint letters permit a literal capture: A/B gives a path, O/A a star, and O/B gives a path after Q1^-1 Q2^2 Q1. Identical endpoint words for every synchronized shift force equal component periods, aligned shared sheets and both repeated within-color lengths. Only the known aligned quadratic lifts are left.

declarations.name: Theorem Y3. Pure path normalization with independent cycle roles
declarations.scope: For arbitrary two-cycle profiles, detaching the A-leaf and reattaching to either B-cycle prescribes beta or exchanges the B internal/leaf roles while keeping A literal. Heavy exchange complements and swaps distances; the conjugate construction independently controls alpha or exchanges A roles while keeping B literal. All operations are pure. Choose the smaller internal lengths, alpha=beta=1 and one T anchor to normalize every path. Conjugates of T under the transitive AB group fixing the isolated sheet generateS_N.

declarations.name: Theorem Y4. All components, markings, groups and sizes
declarations.scope: For all two-cycle-pair plus one-T passports there is exactly one primitiveS_N component under full braids and fixed-order PB3, plus one quadratic component iff a1=a2 andb1=b2. Primitive blocks1,N/deck1; quadraticS2 wrK with K=A_m ifboth repeated lengths odd,elseS_m,blocks1,m,2m/deck2. Ordered totalH=N^2(A0-1)(B0-1)/((1+deltaA)(1+deltaB)); primitive pure literalH minusm^2 whenquadratic, otherwiseH; absolute dividesbyN. Quadratic pure literalm^2,absolutem. Multiply byW=3*(2-indicator(equal heavy multisets)) for full placements. Full twist is pure.

declarations.name: Corollary Y5. The complete two-heavy, one-simple first deficit
declarations.scope: The entire admissible positive first-deficit sector k2,s1,p4 has exactly one primitiveS_N component, plus a second component only for both repeated two-cycle profiles. The2+2 split is Y4. The3+1 split is one arbitrary factor with three nontrivial cycles and q-2 fixed points, q>=3, and tails(q,T); the even T tail gives one component byF2, actualS_N byU1/F3. All three types are distinct, so fixed-order connectivity is pure. Ordered literal total isN^2 q(q-1)/M for M=product of multiplicity factorials of the three nontrivial lengths; absolute dividesbyN and full multipliesby6.
